confidence_notes: Food anchors are grounded in June 2026 aggregated Bangkok price data. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain, estimated at about three times and two-and-a-half times the local draft beer price, respectively. Accommodation values are broad July off-season model estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed: food and drink estimates use Bangkok-specific aggregated prices, while accommodation is modeled from general Bangkok market context.
